verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing docs confirm platform-enforced spending controls including per-authorization and per-month limits, plus real-time authorization webhooks for custom logic, and community evidence confirms this is an API-first control system rather than a UI. However, the evidence doesn't explicitly confirm daily and all-time (lifetime) windows, nor transaction-count velocity rules as distinct from amount caps. missing for 10: explicit documentation of daily/all-time spend windows, explicit transaction-count velocity rule enforcement, independent hands-on confirmation of these specific limit types working as claimed.
